body: Dead session /brief: a notice (ended, resume with claude --resume <id>), no cached brief. Rejected: caching the last brief text in registry.json (stale, only one view/n, grows the registry; the topic already holds every answer and the stream).

ai-title reaches the hub by the hub asking the session's bound agent (session_read title{from}) on UserPromptSubmit/Stop while the title is unknown. Rejected: agent push from its own tail (after /clear the agent keeps a stale env session id, only the hub knows the current session) and a StreamItem in the TASK-016 stream (the stream starts at the file end for resumed sessions and rewinds).

Subagent correlation: hub keeps AgentIndex, agent answers calls{from} in weighted batches with offset/more. Rejected: per-agent-id lookups that rescan the parent transcript each time (up to 5 rescans of a 92 MiB file per subagent).

Subagent block text rendered by the agent from its files plus the hub's last_assistant_message (hook-capped 128 KiB, fits a line); with a SubagentHandback report or without a reading agent the hub builds it from hook data alone. Rejected: agent returns meta + a transcript digest for the hub to render (needs a new transcript-crate API around the Subagent::new order guard).

Wire: one pair HubMsg::SessionRead{read_id,session_id,path,ask} / AgentMsg::SessionAnswer{read_id,answer} behind Register.session_reads, kinds with serde(other); no VERSION bump. Rejected: one message pair per purpose (four pairs, four ingress arms) and reusing transcript_read (its chunk semantics are the stream's).

Path gate: session id from the hub (the session it bound the agent to), canonical path must be /

/.jsonl or /

//subagents/agent-.{jsonl,meta.json}. Rejected: agent-side ownership by its env session id (stale after /clear) or by project dir of the env session (encoding rules, resume from another folder).

Test that the hub cannot see session files: hooks carry paths relative to the agent's cwd, which the in-process hub (other cwd) cannot open; plus a source guard test over src/hub. Rejected: a separate hub process with another HOME (same filesystem, absolute paths stay readable, proves nothing).

Remove SlotLocator/ProjectsDir (sessions.rs), CCTG_PROJECTS_DIR, TopicView and the Slots::new view output since nothing reads them after the change (19 mechanical call-site edits). Rejected: keeping them to spare test churn (dead code in production).

session_read ids are minted with wire::random_u64 (like update_id/key_id), not a per-run counter: the agent outbox keeps unwritten answers across a reconnect, so after a hub restart a stale answer with read_id 1 took the new run's read 1 (reproduced by slots test an_answer_left_from_an_earlier_hub_run_answers_no_read). Rejected: agent drops queued answers on reconnect (touches the shared outbox of every message type).

The agent serves the transcript/subagent files of the session the hub names in session_read (TASK-016 gate semantics); ownership is enforced hub-side by reader()/transcript_reader() (bound, open, not leaving, session_reads). Rejected: agent-side own-session check by env id (stale after /clear) or cwd project dir (encoding, resume from another folder) - the hub is trusted and is the only one that knows the current binding.

AC2 guard matches whole identifiers (fs, metadata, exists, is_file, read_dir, canonicalize, tail, spool, proctree, device, ...) plus File::/reads::answer/files::save paths; the planner's substring list missed use std::{fs as disk}; disk::metadata(p) in slots.rs. Rejected: a transitive call-graph check (disproportionate; the hub uses only pure parts of crate::files and client::own_build for its own exe).

Decision 12: the agent derives its own project folder once at start (tail::own_project): the projects/

folder that already holds .jsonl, else Claude Code's name for its cwd (tail::project_folder_name, non-alphanumeric UTF-16 units -> "-"); the gate then requires the transcript's canonical parent to be that folder, any session id. Rejected: cwd encoding only (misses resumed sessions and Claude Code's shortened long names) and re-deriving per read.

A transcript of another project folder (or every read when the agent has no own folder) answers the new SessionAnswer::Refused, shown as Unavailable::Refused; a missing file stays Missing. Rejected: reusing Missing, which tells the user the file is not written yet.

First gate version canonicalized the own project folder before anything else, so before a new session wrote its first transcript a foreign transcript came back Missing, not Refused; caught by reads_e2e::a_transcript_of_another_project_folder_is_refused, fixed by comparing with the canonical projects root when the own folder does not exist.

Reference test hub::slots::tests::without_an_agent_that_reads_a_block_opens_on_its_stop_from_the_hooks flaked under the parallel slots suite (bind after topic creation adds an alive icon EditTopic); it now waits for bound() and compares against the op count after it. Rejected: longer sleeps.

Verdict NEEDS_WORK: decision-12 own-folder guess (raw cwd, derived once) differs from Claude Code (realpathSync(cwd), 200-char cut+hash) and then refuses the session own files for the agent lifetime, incl. the TASK-016 stream and all subagent blocks; fix by re-deriving from <root>/*/<env id>.jsonl until confirmed and building read paths agent-side (never opening the hub path). Rejected: accepting it as the documented long-name residual (it also hits junction/subst cwds, and the summary misstates the symptom as not-found).

Agent own project folder (tail::OwnProject) is found by the env session's <id>.jsonl under the projects root, looked for on each read until found, then kept; until then folders named after the cwd (canonical and given, Claude Code's dx incl. the 200-char cut + base36 hash) stand in unkept, and reads answer missing. Rejected: dropping the cwd names (a session /cleared before its first record never has an env-id transcript and would be served nothing for its whole life).

session_read loses its path field (unreleased on main; an earlier hub's path is ignored by serde); transcript_read keeps sending the hook path because agents built from main require it, and the new agent binds it to `..` and never opens it. Rejected: removing path from transcript_read too (every pre-TASK-034 agent would fail to decode it and lose the TASK-016 stream).

Another project's session now answers missing, not refused: the agent only builds <own folder>/<id>.jsonl, so it has nothing to compare against and no existence oracle; refused is left for an agent with no session id or config folder. Rejected: probing sibling folders to keep refused (touches files outside the own folder).

A block-text read cut by LinkLost/NoAnswer is parked (bodies_parked, up to 60 s) and re-asked once when reader(parent) is present on a tick; parent ended or timeout gives the hook text. Rejected: putting it straight back into bodies_waiting (start_body_reads settles for the hook text at once while no agent is bound during a TASK-040 swap).

Title backoff counts failures per (session, agent conn); after 4 in a row of one conn the title is not asked of it again, a new conn resets. Rejected: resetting on agent bind (five separate bind sites in slots.rs).

Review 3.5's suggested guard allowlist taken verbatim (files:: only chunks/clean_name, reads:: only MAX_TEXT) fails on correct hub code: fetch.rs/slots.rs use files::room, files::Assembly, files::is_photo, files::default_name and files constants. The guard allows pure files items and any UPPER_CASE constant instead.

QA verdict PASS with minor B1 (hub_reads_no_files guard lets Path::is_dir/is_symlink through, proven by mutation in a %TEMP% clone; .exists() control is caught). Rejected: NEEDS_FIXES for B1, since no such probe exists in hub/ and AC2 holds for the current code.
